extension.summary: BGPVR live TV, films and series
BGPVR телевизия на живо, филми и сериали
extension.description: Browse live TV channels by category, and watch your films and series in Kodi's own player, with posters, plots and resume. Credentials are shared with the BGPVR Setup addon — configure once, works everywhere.

Разглеждайте каналите по категории и гледайте филмите и сериалите си в плейъра на Kodi, с постери, описания и продължаване от мястото, където сте спрели. Данните за вход се споделят с BGPVR Setup addon.
extension.news: v1.1.1 (31 Oct 2026) - Play addresses carry the stream token, never the account password (fetched again once if the server refuses it) v1.1.0 (31 Oct 2026) - Films and Series: browse by category, seasons and episodes; play in Kodi's player (mkv too); Kodi resume - Main menu: Live TV, Films, Series - English and Bulgarian strings; API answers cached for 5 minutes; credentials never written to the log
